processing: Actual 1200x750 pt window captured at Retina resolution with `screencapture -o -l <window>`, converted from the display profile to sRGB. Services are the disposable agents created by producthunt/capture/demo-agents.sh and the list is filtered to `com.launchpane.demo` so no other services appear. Privacy masks fill the listed rectangles with the surrounding panel background. No browser rendering, fabricated service states or substituted UI.

overview.description: Four demo agents in four states: running (backup), loaded with a calendar schedule (cleanup), disabled and unloaded (report), loaded after a failed run (sync).

overview-light.description: The same overview in the Light appearance.

actions.description: Row actions for the running backup agent. Unavailable actions stay visible and explain why (already loaded, already running, already enabled).

sources.description: Service source filter: all services, my agents, user agents, system agents, system daemons and login items.
